    CSDC / CECD at McGill University

    Centre for the Study of Democratic Citizenship

    McGill unit of the CSDC/CECD based at Laval University

    We study democratic citizenship, justice and political behaviors. More about our team, research and upcoming events below.

    Our Research View Upcoming Events See Recent News

    Our Research Focus

    At the CSDC, we work on:

    Learning Democratic Citizenship in an Unequal World

    Focusing on:

    • Digital civic literacy
    • Online political socialization
    • Information literacy
    • Political trust

    The Practice of Democratic Citizenship

    Focusing on:

    • Public perceptions of AI
    • Information consumption
    • AI and deepfake detection
    • Misinformation and fact-checking

    Citizen Representation and Governance

    Focusing on:

    • AI governance and institutions
    • Platform governance and regulation
    • Algorithmic accountability
    • Political representation
